enemy.weakness: Fossilized Second (must be used during a pulse attack). When the player uses the Fossilized Second during a pulse attack, the pulse is reversed for 1 second, causing the boss to stagger and take 50% damage for 3 seconds. The effect can be chained—after the first use, the player can use it again after the boss takes damage (max 3 uses). This is the only way to defeat the boss; it cannot be defeated by direct attack or healing.

encounters.hazard: Pulse attacks cause the ground to ripple. If the player stands in a ripple, movement is reduced to 20% for 4 seconds, and vision is distorted. The player can only move after the ripple ends.

pickup.name: Fossilized Second
pickup.effect: Rewinds the player's last action by exactly 1 second. Cannot be used to undo damage or death. Can be used once per encounter. Must be used during a moment of active combat (e.g., during a pulse attack). If used outside combat, it has no effect.

encounters.trigger: After the Shattered Watcher is defeated, the temporal rift closes and the player is transported to the Still Field. The Still Pulse is fully active and must be defeated using the Fossilized Second pickup. The boss fight has no health bar regeneration. If the player fails to use Fossilized Second during a pulse, the boss gains 10% increased damage and 15% movement speed for 10 seconds as a counter. The fight is over when the player successfully chains three Fossilized Second uses during pulse attacks.

boss.name: The Still Pulse
boss.weakness: Fossilized Second (must be used during a pulse attack). Each use during a pulse causes a 1-second reversal, dealing 50% damage for 3 seconds. The player can chain up to three uses. After the first successful reversal, the boss's attack pattern becomes erratic and less predictable.
boss.victory_condition: The player must trigger three successful Fossilized Second reversals during the boss’s pulse attacks. After the third, the Still Pulse dissolves into mist and the jungle begins to heal. The time shard and fossilized second are left behind as relics of the encounter.

level.objective: Survive the three encounters and defeat the Still Pulse. The player must use time-based mechanics and pickups strategically. The final boss is only accessible after defeating the Shattered Watcher, and its weakness is a pickup obtained during the second encounter.
level.reward: Chrono-Leaf (a rare bioluminescent plant that grows when time is frozen. Can be used to slow time by 30% for 15 seconds when planted.) and +25% chronomancer skill points.

level.setting: A collapsed river delta, where ancient trees have become skeletal remains, and the riverbed is cracked, dry, and choked with rot. Vines strangle the air. The only light comes from flickering embers in the ruins of a long-dead temple. The jungle is silent—except for groans and distant, choked breaths. The wind carries no sound.

encounters.location: Near the dried riverbed, where the ground is cracked and black with moss and ash. A broken stone pillar stands, inscribed with half-burnt runes.

enemy.name: Worm-Crusher Wyrms
enemy.weakness: The player's Cracked Black Axe deals extra damage to the Wyrms when it's swung in a staggered, wild motion—like a berserker’s rage swing. This damage is amplified when the axe is swung in a 3-second rage burst (player rage meter > 70%).

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable. Every 20 seconds, the player must avoid a sudden sinkhole that deals 20% of current health if stepped on. No recovery—only dodge or risk it.

pickup.name: Shattered Runic Fragment
pickup.effect: When picked up, this fragment temporarily grants the player a 25% increase in rage duration and a 15% damage boost to melee attacks. It also allows the player to trigger the next encounter if they defeat the Wyrms within 10 seconds of the fight ending (ranged timer). This creates a pressure-cooker environment—failure to act fast means the next enemy appears sooner and stronger.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wyrms and picking up the Shattered Runic Fragment, the player must survive 30 seconds without a rage burst (or the rage meter drops below 30%) before the second enemy appears. If the rage drops below 30%, the next encounter triggers earlier and with a 20% health penalty.

encounters.location: A collapsed temple chamber, lined with jagged bone walls. The air is thick with silence and the smell of damp bone. Faint whispers echo from the walls.

enemy.name: Silent Scurry
enemy.weakness: The Silent Scurry is vulnerable to attacks that use the Shattered Runic Fragment's amplified rage damage. The fragment's damage boost (15%) must be active during the attack. The Scurry can only take one such strike before retreating. If the player fails to land it, the Scurry spawns a shadow clone that attacks from behind—giving it a +15% damage and -15% health per second for 5 seconds.

encounters.hazard: A rotating wind blade (25% damage per second) spins in a corner every 30 seconds. The blade becomes active only if the player stands within 2 meters. It can't be avoided—only dodged by moving through a narrow crevice or using the Fang-Bone Shard to absorb the damage.

pickup.name: Fang-Bone Shard
pickup.effect: The Fang-Bone Shard can be used to create a temporary shield (20 health) when the player is under attack. However, using it consumes 30% of the player’s rage. It also activates a passive 'Berserker Surge' after 40 seconds of continuous combat. If the player uses it, the next encounter triggers automatically after 5 seconds, and the boss fight begins if the player survives 40 seconds without taking 60 damage.

encounters.trigger: If the player defeats the Silent Scurry and picks up the Fang-Bone Shard, the next encounter will trigger immediately after the fight ends. The player must use the shard to activate the berserker surge to survive the next stage. If they don’t use it, the environment becomes unstable and a collapsing ceiling triggers an immediate boss fight with no warning.

encounters.location: Deep in the temple ruins, beneath a fallen canopy of rotting vines. The floor is mossy and slippery. The center has a pulsating, hollow root that hums like a dying heart.

enemy.name: The Hollow Root
enemy.weakness: The Hollow Root is vulnerable to attacks that use the Fang-Bone Shard’s shield. When the player activates the shield during an attack, the Root’s core explodes for 50% of its health. However, only the *first* shield activation in a 30-second window counts. A second shield use causes the Root to lash out with a shockwave that deals 50 damage and knocks the player back 3 meters. If the player fails to use the shield, the Root drains 15% of the player’s health every 5 seconds until it is defeated or the player dies.

encounters.hazard: A low-frequency pulse every 15 seconds causes the player to take 20 damage and lose 20% of rage. If rage drops below 10%, the player must dodge a sudden root-spike that deals 40 damage and knocks them back.

pickup.name: Core of the First Root
pickup.effect: This is the final pickup. It grants a temporary passive ability: 'Root's Pulse'—when the player takes damage, they instantly gain 50% of the damage as rage. If the player defeats the Hollow Root, they gain access to the boss fight. The Core of the First Root must be used during the final attack on the Hollow Root to initiate the boss battle. If not used, the boss fight begins after 30 seconds of inactivity or after the Hollow Root is defeated with no shield use.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Hollow Root and using the Core of the First Root, the player enters a final corridor with a glowing, pulsating doorway. The door opens only if the player has used the Core of the First Root during the fight. If not, the player is teleported to the boss fight immediately, with no recovery or warning.

boss.name: The Gargantuan Root-Maw
boss.weakness: The Gargantuan Root-Maw is only vulnerable when the player uses the Core of the First Root during its final phase. The Core must be used within 5 seconds of the boss's final health drop (from 200 to 100). Using it instantly causes the boss to explode for 75 damage to nearby enemies (a player benefit), but the player takes 100 damage and must survive 2 seconds of chaos. If the Core is not used, the boss becomes unkillable and begins a phase of continuous rage attacks, increasing in damage by 20 per second.
boss.victory_condition: Player must land the final attack using the Core of the First Root within 5 seconds of the boss's health dropping to 100. If successful, the player gains a permanent 'Rage Resonance' ability (next fight, rage gains 10% from damage taken). If failed, the player is left in the jungle with no progress—only a memory of the struggle and a 10% chance of being teleported back to the beginning with a 30% health loss.

level.objective: Destroy the Hollow Root and use the Core of the First Root to trigger the final confrontation with The Gargantuan Root-Maw. The journey must be completed under pressure, with each encounter setting the stage for the next. Success is not just about killing—it's about surviving the brutality of the jungle and the cost of rage.
level.reward: The 'Jungle Heart Fragment' — a unique item that can be used to create a passive 'Rage Feed' ability: recovering 10 health per second from environmental heat. This is earned only after using the Core of the First Root successfully against the boss.
